criteria.criterion: Only missing applicable optional credential kinds are recommended by exact operation, host and verified requirements, never by broad tool family or invented God-Mode-only privileges.
criteria.evidence: PARTIAL: exact reviewed operation resolver and negative synthetic cases exist. Optional-kind enrollment/recommendation is not fully integrated.

criteria.criterion: Every stored extra grant binds provider host, numeric verified human identity, tenant/workspace, account, resource/enterprise scope, token kind, permissions, expiry and verification without exposing the secret.
criteria.evidence: PARTIAL: existing private App-user U grant now binds current ciphertext, subject, tenant and epochs, account/App/installation, GitHub.com, expiry and exact identity read. Additional credential kinds and non-GitHub.com enrollment remain unfinished.

criteria.criterion: One agent-initiated secure setup handoff uses native GitHub App/OAuth consent or the protected service token page only as applicable, returns to its originating scoped client and rechecks capability; no chat-token input.
criteria.evidence: PARTIAL: existing private native App-user consent attaches identity-read proof and returns through its original registered client PKCE flow. Agent-initiated additional-kind protected/native upgrade enrollment remains unfinished.

criteria.criterion: No silent broader fallback, trial-and-error provider authentication, unsupported pass downscoping or unintended privilege carryover during denied provider requests, upgrades or refresh.
criteria.evidence: PARTIAL: resolver forbids silent fallback and revoked/expired/foreign/stale metadata; unsupported private-user pass downscope is separately isolated in security PR #275. Full additional-kind dispatch/lifecycle still unfinished.

criteria.criterion: Disposable PostgreSQL and synthetic-provider integration prove two distinct tenants, the same human in separate workspaces, wrong identity/host/resource, stale/revoked grants, concurrency and interrupted setup.
criteria.evidence: PARTIAL: 48 focused unit tests pass and new disposable PostgreSQL scenarios cover the existing U foundation, with native consent/refresh cases extended. DB execution and full synthetic-provider additional-kind handoff tests still required.

criteria.criterion: Tests prove secret redaction, restricted service passes, clean replacement/deletion and verified before/after capability gain; incomplete real provider/device acceptance remains independently OPEN.
criteria.evidence: PARTIAL: ciphertext/metadata redaction, restricted-pass refusal, U replacement proof invalidation and identity-read before/after assertions exist. Additional-kind readback and cleanup proofs plus independent real acceptance remain open.

remainingEngineering: Typed applicable optional credential registry and protected enrollment for kinds beyond existing private App-user U, bound to explicit host/human/tenant/account/resource and current authorization context.
Agent-initiated registered-client upgrade handoff with correct native/protected provider flow, one-use state, automatic return and interruption recovery.
Exact operation/resource harmless capability readback beyond GET /user, with honest unknowns and no fallback or provider write retry.
Full additional-kind expiry/refresh/replace/revoke/delete and restricted-pass lifecycle integration.

Complete original synthetic-provider/two-tenant PostgreSQL integration, exact-head CI, review and frozen delivery comparison before merge; independent real provider/device acceptance remains separate.

newEngineering: Existing sealed private U grant metadata binding, native consent/refresh attachment, epoch/CAS invalidation and scoped diagnostic integration. Separate four-line restricted-pass security fix is PR #275 and is not credited as a completed CAP subsection.
planComparison: CONTINUE: original six whole criteria remain incomplete. Recovered the existing-U binding foundation through a narrower metadata change without another bearer store; original optional-kind registry/enrollment outcome is not complete.
